An '''unidentified long-necked furry species''', with slender bodies, long necks, and elongated faces, possessing tufts of hair around their mouths, as well as four-fingered hands and medium-length tails. While still early into their development, this species was discovered by the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]], who converted their homeworld into a mining colony and illegally exploited and abused the native population, forcing them to mine valuable raw material for minimal wages. 

While the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] turned a blind eye to Karflo's disreputable practices, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]] began to uncover similar "development colonies"<ref name="GG8S">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> such as [[Gargolyn IV]],<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> potentially including the one housing this species as well, causing the new governing body to confirm they had no leniency for such illicit activities with the intent to take action against them.<ref name="GG8S" />
